from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import MultiCut, CartesianCut, Bin

# Define jet multiplicity binning (exactly 4, exactly 5, at least 6 jets)
njets = MultiCut(
    name="njets",
    label="N(JetGood)",
    bins=[
        Bin(name="4j", label="exactly 4 jets", cut="nJetGood == 4"),
        Bin(name="5j", label="exactly 5 jets", cut="nJetGood == 5"),
        Bin(name="6j", label="≥6 jets", cut="nJetGood >= 6"),
    ]
)

# Define b-tag multiplicity binning (exactly 2, at least 3 b-jets)
nbtags = MultiCut(
    name="nbtags",
    label="N(BJetGood)",
    bins=[
        Bin(name="2b", label="exactly 2 b-tags", cut="nBJetGood == 2"),
        Bin(name="3b", label="≥3 b-tags", cut="nBJetGood >= 3"),
    ]
)

categories = CartesianCut(
    name="analysis",
